reviews.title: Pro covered its cost on the first project
reviews.review_text: We started free, then chose Pro at €49 per month for the LTS updates. The first upgrade took one afternoon, which covered a year of fees.

reviewer_image.title: Portrait of Daniel Okafor
reviewer_image.alternative: A man with dark skin, very short hair and a short beard, wearing a navy blazer.

reviews.title: The €890 installation was worth it
reviews.review_text: The maintainers set up everything in one day: styleguide, theme and an editor briefing. With a backend preview for all 244 elements, training our 12 editors took an afternoon.

reviewer_image.title: Portrait of Mei-Ling Tan
reviewer_image.alternative: A woman with a sleek black bob, a navy blazer and a white T-shirt.

reviews.title: Managed hosting that runs smoothly
reviews.review_text: We moved to managed hosting at €99/month, with updates, daily backups, monitoring and an EU data centre. I’d like staging in the base plan, not only in the €179 Business plan.
